verses.19:82: كَلَّاۚ سَيَكۡفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمۡ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ضِدًّا

meaning: The root ضدد (Ddd) primarily signifies opposition, contrariety, or being an antagonist. It denotes something that is against or contrary to another, whether in nature, action, or opinion.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
